input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also be signed by the moving piece's own key and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, and any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text or /moves/pawn_d7.text must be co-signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen keys, so that greedy or amnesiac off-plan moves from these repeat offenders cannot be accepted.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_d7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
